SELECT i.report_data, i.nc AS nc, c."ocsGroup" AS ocsgroup, c."esetEmail" AS esetemail,
  c.contrato_servidores, c.contrato_servidores_virt, c.contrato_estaciones
FROM crm_cache.informes i JOIN crm_cache.clientes c ON c."nombreCorto" = i.nc
WHERE i.id = {{ Number($json.body.informeId) || 0 }}

SELECT hostname, source, source_match, hardware_uuid, eset_uuid, mac, bios_serial, os
FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario
WHERE LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(workgroup, '\.local$', '', 'i')) = LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE('{{ String($('get_contexto').first().json.ocsgroup || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '\.local$', '', 'i'))
   OR (workgroup = 'unknown-eset' AND LOWER(eset_email) = LOWER('{{ String($('get_contexto').first().json.esetemail || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
